1. Revision history¶

1.1. Version 1.0¶

  • Initial version.

1.2. Version 1.0.1¶

  • Use lcf_utils 1.0.1 and iLock_Geography 1.5.1 to fix crash when parsing RJSON on systems with a .NET framework version < 4.7.1

1.3. Version 1.0.2¶

  • Bug fix: Support reading and dumping files containing non-ascii characters.

  • Use iLock_Geography 1.5.2 to fix file encoding issue.

  • Bug fix: Make compatible with .NET framework version 4.5.1 - 4.7.

1.4. Version 1.0.3¶

  • Update dependency of iLock_Geography to 1.6.

1.5. Version 2.0¶

  • Get rid of the lcf_dir and namespace_sep_char configuration parameters. The library now gets the configuration data used with iLock_Geography and om_integration directly from those packages instead of through intermediate files.

  • Update dependency of iLock_Geography to 2.0.

  • Add dependency on om_integration 2.0.

1.6. Version 2.0.1¶

  • Update dependency on iLock_Geography to 2.0.1.

1.7. Version 2.0.2¶

  • Update dependency on iLock_Geography to 2.1.

  • Fix crash if a user type that did not end up being instantiated in the railyard occurred as a table type in a primary table. All user types present in primary tables are now included in Types.lcf.

1.8. Version 3.0¶

  • The library now requires the mapping from PAR_* and INT_* functions in the HLL model to their corresponding object model constructs to be provided explicitly. As a consequence, the library is no longer dependent on how the PiSPEC GSS is structured.

1.9. Version 3.0.1¶

  • The object types DirectedInsideObject and SwitchObject are now always included in the generated Types.lcf, even if there are no railyard entities using them. These are required by the LCF2HLL tool chain.

1.10. Version 3.0.2¶

  • Python 3 compatibility

1.11. Version 3.1¶

  • Add configuration option to set strict mode (true by default). Fixed a bug related this.

  • HLL Sort names can contain numbers. Allow this in regex matching sorts defined in Sorts.hll.

  • Dump LCF2-* files as .lmc instead of .json.

1.12. Version 3.2¶

  • Dump files in the LCF 2.0 and LMC 2.0 formats.

  • Add configuration option for turning off user type filtering.

1.13. Version 3.2.1¶

  • Updated om_integration version

  • Updated iLock_Geography version

1.14. Version 3.2.2¶

  • Fix incorrect field names for LCF2Par and LCF2Tab.

  • Mark InnerJoinT, NextAreaInPathT, and MatchT as certified table methods.

  • Include tables from InnerJointT’s arguments (table1 and table2) for LCF2Par generation.

  • Add configuration option for turning off filtering of unused primary tables. This is needed when the lcf tables used for Prover Certifier are not exported from this package, instead from the original input imported into Prover iLock.

  • Dump lcf tables based on the Types.lcf generated by this package.

1.15. Version 3.3¶

  • Update dependency on iLock_Geography to 5.0

  • Add support for pipelines and local table types in LCF2Tab. Note that only certified table methods may be used with these at the moment.

  • Add support for integer parameters.

  • LCF2Inst rules with an empty mapping list are now always preserved.

1.16. Version 3.3.1¶

  • Update dependency on iLock_Geography to 5.0.1

1.17. Version 3.3.2¶

  • Updated lcf_utils version.

  • Updated iLock_Geography version.

  • Fixed too aggressive filtering of user types. User types that are used to uniquely identify nodes of degree 3 or higher must be preserved, or else the compact railyard representation becomes ambiguous.

1.18. Version 3.3.3¶

  • Updated iLock_Geography version.
